verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs describe an invisible bot-protection check (an 'invisible CAPTCHA') that guards sensitive routes from sophisticated bots without showing users a challenge. This matches the story's core of invisible, challenge-style bot protection, and the WAF entry adds broader bot and scraper blocking. missing for 10: detailed docs on integration, how the challenge works, and its configuration and pricing; independent or hands-on corroboration that it stops bots in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect my app from automated bot traffic with invisible challenge-based protection

citations.quote: An invisible CAPTCHA that protects against sophisticated bots without challenges.
Protect sensitive routes from sophisticated bots with an invisible check instead of a CAPTCHA.
